# OMICS Online

> > OMICS Online publishes open-access research across clinical medicine, mental health, palliative care, earth sciences, and biomedical techniques.

The platform features peer-reviewed articles from international researchers addressing global health challenges, with particular emphasis on palliative medicine, psychiatric care, child and adolescent behavior, and emerging therapeutic approaches including CBT and crisis intervention.

## Key Topics

- Palliative Care
- End-of-Life Care
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Adolescent Mental Health
- Pain Management
- Hospice Care
- Psychotherapy
- Trauma-Informed Care
- Advance Care Planning
- Quality of Life
- Bereavement Support
- Arab Region Healthcare
- Cultural Sensitivity
- Digital Health
- Crisis Intervention

## Psychiatric and Mental Health Care

- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapy: Transforming Mental Well-being and Coping](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/cognitive-behavioral-therapy-transforming-mental-wellbeing-and-coping-139113.html): CBT approaches for mental health by Dr. Priya Nair, Kerala Institute
- [Integrated Psychiatric Care: A Comprehensive Future](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/integrated-psychiatric-care-a-comprehensive-future-139103.html): Integrated psychiatric care approaches by Devendra Kumar, Bundelkhand Univ
- [Advancing Mental Health: Research, Treatments, and Future](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/advancing-mental-health-research-treatments-and-future-139110.html): Mental health treatments including psilocybin by Dr. Aaron Mitchell
- [Women's Mental Health: Factors, Stages, and Interventions](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/womens-mental-health-factors-stages-and-interventions-139263.html): Women's mental health interventions by Dr. Salma Ben Ali
- [Crisis Intervention: Immediate Support, Safety, and Long-Term Outcomes](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/crisis-intervention-immediate-support-safety-and-longterm-outcomes-139261.html): Crisis intervention techniques by Dr. Helen Porter, Lakeside Health
- [Advancing Child Adolescent Mental Health: Research and Care](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/advancing-child-adolescent-mental-health-research-and-care-139232.html): Child mental health research by Dr. Fatima Al-Sayed, Gulf Medical Univ

## Palliative and Hospice Care

- [Palliative Care: Arab Region, Needs, and Opportunities](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/palliative-care-arab-region-needs-and-opportunities-2165-7386-1000827-139358.html): Palliative care needs in Arab region by Zainab Al-Farsi
- [Palliative Care: Holistic Well-being in Illness](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/palliative-care-holistic-wellbeing-in-illness-2165-7386-1000794-139218.html): Holistic palliative care approach by Sophia Caldwell, St. Mercy University
- [Palliative & Hospice Care: A Comprehensive Approach](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/palliative--hospice-care-a-comprehensive-approach-2165-7386-1000813-139276.html): Comprehensive palliative care by Samuel Johansen, University of Oslo
- [Hospice Care: Opioids, Advance Care, Bereavement](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/hospice-care-opioids-advance-care-bereavement-2165-7386-1000839-139576.html): Hospice care opioid stewardship by Robert J. Callahan
- [Palliative Care: Improving Oncology Patient Experiences](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/palliative-care-improving-oncology-patient-experiences-139128.html): Oncology palliative care by Yasmin Khatri, Kuwait

## Child and Adolescent Behavior

- [Emotional Regulation: Across Ages, Contexts, and Outcomes](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/emotional-regulation-across-ages-contexts-and-outcomes-139190.html): Emotional regulation research by Dr. M. Chen using fMRI techniques
- [Child Cognitive Development: Pathways and Influences](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/child-cognitive-development-pathways-and-influences-139193.html): Child cognitive development pathways by Dr. S. Patel, India
- [Multidimensional Approach to School Behavior Problems](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/multidimensional-approach-to-school-behavior-problems-2375-4494-1000765-139201.html): School behavior interventions by Dr. N. Yamamoto, Japan

## Clinical Specialties and Therapeutics

- [Surgical Techniques Minimize Transplant Complications](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/surgical-techniques-minimize-transplant-complications-2475-7640-1000305-139556.html): Transplant surgical techniques by Andrew Wallace, Glasgow Medical Univ
- [Tinnitus and Vestibular Dysfunction: Treatment and Management](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/tinnitus-and-vestibular-dysfunction-treatment-and-management-139147.html): Tinnitus and vestibular treatment by Hanae Sato, Kyoto Medical University
- [Periodontal Health: Global Issues, Advanced Therapies, and Biomarkers](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/periodontal-health-global-issues-advanced-therapies-and-biomarkers-jdpm-1000311-139552.html): Periodontal disease therapies by Dr. Lillian Okafor, Abuja Dental Univ

## Bioanalytical Techniques and Research Methods

- [qPCR: Methods, Applications, and Ensuring Reliable Results](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/qpcr-methods-applications-and-ensuring-reliable-results-2155-9872-1000832-139608.html): qPCR methods and applications by Dr. Beatriz Ramos, Bogotá Genomics

## Earth Science and Climate Research

- [Heat Waves: Arid Regions Face Growing Threats](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/heat-waves-arid-regions-face-growing-threats-2157-7617-1000958-139435.html): Heat wave threats in arid regions by Dr. Hassan Al-Mahdi, Saudi Arabia
- [Earth's Atmospheric Circulation: Weather and Climate Impacts](https://www.omicsonline.org/open-access/earths-atmospheric-circulation-weather-and-climate-impacts-2157-7617-1000962-139453.html): Atmospheric circulation patterns by Prof. Katarzyna Nowak, Warsaw
